title: Case: Delivery notification contains an unusable tracking link
context: A notification points to a malformed path. Support must provide the correct shipment reference without asking the customer to follow an unknown link.
initial_request: The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.

events.body: DL-7357 notification path was truncated by our template. The account-linked notification belongs to this recipient; the shipment reference itself is intact in our order record.
The tracking link in my notification does not open. Please give me the correct way to find this parcel in the order portal.
Please send Ianthe the correct DL-7357 tracking reference and portal navigation through the verified order thread. Do not send a payment request or ask for credentials.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Notification support, Rookhaven Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Tracking access is not delivery. No live URL or credentials are provided.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-017: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 3) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
